harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Stood up a fresh 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6), wrote application keys, then simulated the permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory while node1/node2 retained quorum. Removed the dead member (551e3d60e1e0c3b9) via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 (87e9d437b9aadf7d) with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started etcd fresh on node3 — it rejoined, synced via raft, and now serves all original application keys. Verified 3/3 healthy members and full data integrity. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-reboot, and verified etcd came back active with full 3-member health and intact application data after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3
Configured systemd etcd.service units and opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all nodes
Bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (node1, node2, node3)
Wrote 4 application keys under /app/ prefix and confirmed replication to all members including node3
Simulated permanent loss of node3 member: stopped etcd, disabled service, wiped /var/lib/etcd data
Verified node1/node2 quorum preserved and app keys intact with node3 down
Removed dead member 551e3d60e1e0c3b9 via etcdctl member remove
Added new member for node3 (87e9d437b9aadf7d) via etcdctl member add with existing-cluster state
Reconfigured node3's systemd unit with initial-cluster-state=existing and started etcd, confirming it joined and synced all app data
Verified full 3/3 member health and data integrity post-replacement
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes
Sequentially restarted node1, node2, node3 (one at a time), polling until reachable and confirming boot_id changed
Verified etcd active, 3/3 member health, and application keys intact after each node's restart

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members; app keys written on node1 and confirmed readable on node3 via replication

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped/disabled and data wiped on node3; node1/node2 endpoint health true, node3 unreachable, app keys still readable via node1

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replaced with new working member on node3
evidence.summary: member remove of old ID 551e3d60e1e0c3b9, member add for node3 (new ID 87e9d437b9aadf7d), etcd started successfully on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing

evidence.requirement: Cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: endpoint health true for all 3 endpoints, member list shows 3 started members, node3 get /app --prefix returns all 4 original keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered cluster/data
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 8c28f3cd... to a2a0b3c6...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 member health, app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered cluster/data
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from e65e6bcf... to 234ef1c6...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 member health, app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered cluster/data
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 54089086... to 6416feab...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 member health, replaced member rejoined with app keys intact
